verdict: Caution: lend selectively to Ahmedabad formulation and API units with verified order books and clean receivables; avoid small contract-research shops with US-client concentration until their demand recovery is proven.
title: Ahmedabad Pharmaceuticals & APIs: a note to the credit manager
narrative: So when a proposal lands, check the receivable ageing and inventory days before you look at the machinery quote; if receivables past 90 days exceed a fifth of sales, ask for the buyer-wise ledger and the last two years' write-offs.

## What has changed now
**The official data pack reads CAUTION at 46, and the news flow is mixed rather than bad.** Gujarat GST collections are running +11.9% Apr-to-date against India's +6.1% [D], a genuine local tailwind, but India-wide output is -2.1% Apr-to-date while bank credit is +21.6% YoY [D] — money is chasing a shrinking output base. Peer results are strong: Aarti Pharmalabs posted record quarterly revenue of Rs. 613 crore, up 47% YoY, with EBITDA margin at 22.2% [4][6], and RPG Life Sciences grew Q2 FY27 revenue 16.5% to Rs. 211.6 crore [7] even as its share price fell over 10% [7]. Read that as: the good units are doing well, the market is punishing anything less.

## Where the growth is
**Pursue the mid-size API and CDMO units riding the outsourcing wave, and the formulation exporters with a real ANDA or registration pipeline.** RPG is targeting 25% API growth and eyeing another acquisition within 12 months [5]; Aarti is expanding CDMO and ramping Xanthine capacity [6]. Amneal has opened an Ahmedabad office for 1,200 employees [1], and local coverage explicitly frames Ahmedabad as a growing pharma hub [2] — that means vendor and service spend will land on smaller local units. **Avoid** sub-Rs.100 crore contract-research shops: one rated peer at Rs. 61.0 crore FY2024 revenue saw orders hit by weak US client demand and carries high customer concentration [9].

## How to grow safely
**Structure against the working-capital cycle, not the building.** Take monthly stock-and-receivable statements, a quarterly buyer-wise sales mix, and GST returns reconciled to sales. Where a unit's working-capital utilisation has fallen from 70-90% to 40-50% [8], ask why before treating it as a strength — it may be lost orders. Insist on a minimum current ratio covenant and a cap on single-buyer concentration; if one buyer crosses a third of sales, ask for that buyer's payment history.

## Early warning signs
**Watch receivables ageing, US order intake and power consumption at the unit.** Gujarat electricity demand is +11.0% Apr-to-date versus India's +9.5% [D] — a unit running below that pace is likely under-utilised. Note that the rating sources [8][9][10] are dated 2024 and older; treat them as background, not current. Local sources say little specific about Ahmedabad credit conditions, so lean on first principles and these peers.
